propositions: Job-level always() predicates on seven full-route jobs remain true during GitHub workflow cancellation, preventing superseded matrix and reusable jobs from being canceled promptly.
A classifier failure must still launch the full-route fallback, but a superseding-patchset cancellation must not preserve or launch stale full-route work.

Replacing always() with !cancelled() status checks in the seven full-route job predicates restores cancellation eligibility while preserving docs-only routing and classifier-failure fallback behavior.

Pre-fix behavior showed 1,510 seconds of successor admission delay and 1,785 runner-seconds consumed after replacement creation; post-fix same-change pairs demonstrate cancellation within 60–110 seconds of replacement run creation.
